shortBio.en: Black Sabbath bassist and primary lyricist; occult/war themes under Iommi riffs.
shortBio.zh: Black Sabbath 贝斯手与主作词；Iommi riff 下的玄学/战争主题。

whyHub.en: Bass + words as one job: low end locks the riff while lyrics name the Sabbath worldview.
whyHub.zh: 贝斯 + 歌词合一：低频锁住 riff，歌词命名 Sabbath 世界观。

body.en:
Born 1949, Birmingham. In the Ozzy-era four, Butler’s bass doubles and answers Iommi’s riffs; he writes most early lyrics (Paranoid, War Pigs, Black Sabbath). Leaves and returns across 80s–90s lineup churn; reunions keep him on the founding axis with Iommi.

Hub value: metal’s early lyric frame sits with the bass chair, not a separate poet.
body.zh:
1949 年生于伯明翰。在 Ozzy 时期四人组，Butler 贝斯加倍/应答 Iommi riff；早期歌词多出其手（Paranoid、War Pigs、Black Sabbath）。80–90 年代阵容动荡中离队又归队；重聚时仍与 Iommi 同处创始轴。

枢纽价值：早期金属歌词框架落在贝斯席，而非另设诗人。

note.zh: 创始 Ozzy 时期贝斯/作词。

note.en: Returns across Dio and later 80s–90s chapters; intermittent exits.
note.zh: Dio 与后续 80–90 年代章节回归；有间歇离队。
与 Iommi 的重聚与后期章节。
